missing_value: Empty CSV fields mean unavailable; numeric zero means measured zero.

run_modes.release: Authoritative host-facing latency and throughput; instrumentation disabled.
run_modes.cuda-timing: CUDA-event and host-stage diagnostics; never substitutes for release latency.
run_modes.telemetry: Long-running release workload with external power, thermal, clock, and utilization sampling.
run_modes.nsight-systems: Short timeline diagnosis; never a percentile source.
run_modes.nsight-compute: Representative kernel counters; never a request-latency source.

metrics.name: energy_per_query
metrics.source: trapezoidal integration of an identified power rail

metrics.name: cuda_stage
metrics.source: CUDA events on the execution stream

metrics.name: transfer
metrics.source: backend byte counts and CUDA events

metrics.name: memory
metrics.source: backend allocation accounting and OS RSS
